page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6a.xlarge is a memory-optimized instance running on the KVM hypervisor, built on the x86_64 architecture. Compute is delivered by an AMD EPYC 7H12 processor operating at a base frequency of 2.6 GHz, providing 4 dedicated vCPUs distributed across 2 physical cores with 2 threads per core. The instance is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, establishing an 8.0 GB per vCPU allocation ratio. Cache hierarchy includes 32 KB of L1 data cache, 0.5 MB of L2 cache, and 16 MB of L3 cache, complemented by support for AVX, AES, and SHA-NI instruction sets. The server profile includes no bundled local storage, requiring network-attached storage solutions, and features a baseline network throughput of 2 Gbps. No graphical processing units are included in this configuration.

Benchmark evaluations reflect the memory-focused and modest compute positioning of the server. In Geekbench tests, the instance records a single-core score of 1237.0 and a multi-core score of 2816.0. Synthetic compute evaluation through PassMark yields an overall CPU score of 5352.43 and an encryption score of 4228.49, while stress-ng records 766.78 for single-core and 1533.17 for multi-core performance. Memory throughput reaches 200.22 GB/sec for small 16 KB cached read blocks, 29.06 GB/sec for uncached 256 MB reads, and 15.26 GB/sec for uncached writes, corroborated by a PassMark memory score of 2075.12. In I/O and compression testing, single-threaded gzip compression achieves 23.87 GB/sec, while static web serving throughput measures at 3.85 GB/sec.

The hardware design delivers resource density focused strictly on memory capacity rather than raw compute scaling. The 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio offers cost efficiency for memory-resident workloads by avoiding overprovisioning compute cores just to access higher RAM thresholds. The operational tradeoffs include modest multi-core computing power and reliance on remote storage across a 2 Gbps network baseline. Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6a.xlarge is best matched for in-memory data stores, caching layers, mid-tier database hosting, distributed messaging brokers, and memory-constrained web application environments.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6a.xlarge is a memory-optimized instance powered by an AMD EPYC 7H12 processor clocked at 2.6 GHz. Operating on the KVM hypervisor with x86_64 architecture, the instance provides 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 2 physical cores alongside 32 GB of system RAM, yielding an 8 GB per vCPU ratio. The configuration includes no dedicated local storage and features a 2 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, with zero integrated GPUs. Benchmark evaluations show moderate single-thread execution with a Geekbench score of 1237, alongside a PassMark memory score of 2075.12, though overall compute throughput in multi-core stress-ng tests remains in lower percentiles. The primary advantage lies in memory density relative to core count, making ecs.r6a.xlarge well matched for memory-intensive caching tiers, in-memory data processing, distributed application nodes, and lightweight database workloads where memory footprint takes priority over aggressive parallel processing power.
